clue.text: Bombed Rugby and Slough

definitions.note: to bomb along is to go very fast, so bombed means rushed

parts.note: RU is the abbreviation for Rugby Union
to slough is to shed, as a snake does its skin

explanation.surface: A news item listing two English towns, Rugby and Slough, that were hit by bombing.
explanation.walkthrough: Rugby and Slough look like a pair of English towns; one is a sport and the other a verb. 'Bombed' in the sense of moving at speed is informal, chiefly British.
explanation.definitionFit: Informally, to bomb is to travel very fast, so bombed is a past-tense synonym of hurried.
